paper_summary: 证明了 Katalin Marton 提出的多项式 Freiman-Ruzsa 猜想在特征 2 下的情形。该猜想断言：若 A ⊂ F₂ⁿ 是倍常数为 K 的集合，则 A 可被至多 2K^C 个陪集覆盖，其中 H 是大小不超过 |A| 的子群。本文证明了 C=12 成立。证明采用熵方法和变分框架，通过构造适当的随机变量对并最小化含惩罚项的泛函来完成。

main_theorems.label: Conjecture 1 (PFR Conjecture)
main_theorems.statement: Suppose that A ⊂ F₂ⁿ is a set with |A+A| ≤ K|A|. Then A is covered by at most 2K^C cosets of some subgroup H ≤ F₂ⁿ of size at most |A|.

proof_methods.method: 熵方法 + 变分最小化 + 纤维引理 + Balog-Szemerédi-Gowers 引理
proof_methods.detail: 通过最小化含惩罚项的 tau 泛函，构造四种候选随机变量对（和与纤维），若均不成功则进入终局论证利用特征 2 的特殊性质导出矛盾

main_theorems.label: Theorem pfr-entropy
main_theorems.statement: Let G = F₂ⁿ, and suppose that X¹₀, X²₀ are G-valued random variables. Then there is some subgroup H ≤ G such that d(X¹₀, U_H) + d(X²₀, U_H) ≤ 11·d(X¹₀, X²₀), where U_H denotes the uniform distribution on H. Furthermore, both d(X¹₀, U_H) and d(X²₀, U_H) are at most 6·d(X¹₀, X²₀).

proof_methods.method: 由 Proposition de-prop 通过紧性/极小化论证推导
proof_methods.detail: 选择 tau 泛函的极小元，利用 de-prop 的逆否推出距离为 0，再由 Lemma lem:100pc 得到子群

main_theorems.label: Proposition de-prop
main_theorems.statement: Let X₁, X₂ be two G-valued random variables with d(X₁, X₂) > 0. Then there are G-valued random variables X'₁, X'₂ such that τ[X'₁; X'₂] < τ[X₁; X₂], where τ[X₁; X₂] := d(X₁, X₂) + η·d(X¹₀, X₁) + η·d(X²₀, X₂) with η = 1/9.

proof_methods.method: 反证法 + 四种构造 + 终局论证
proof_methods.detail: 假设对所有 X'₁,X'₂ 有 τ 不减，测试和构造与纤维构造，推导互信息上界，进入终局用特征 2 的 pairwise independent 性质导出矛盾

main_theorems.label: Theorem th13
main_theorems.statement: Let A be a finite subset of Z^D for some D, and suppose that |A+A| ≤ K|A|. Then there is some set A' ⊆ A, |A'| ≥ K^{-C₁/₂}|A|, with dim A' ≤ C₂ log K, for some absolute constants C₁, C₂ > 0.

proof_methods.method: 由 pfr-entropy 通过 GMT 论文的论证推导
proof_methods.detail: 该结果解决了 [GMT] 中提出的猜想

entities.label: Theorem pfr-entropy
entities.statement: Let G = F2^n, X1_0, X2_0 be G-valued r.v.'s. Then ∃ subgroup H ≤ G s.t. d(X1_0,U_H) + d(X2_0,U_H) ≤ 11·d(X1_0,X2_0) and both ≤ 6·d(X1_0,X2_0).

entities.label: Proposition de-prop
entities.statement: If d(X1,X2) > 0 then ∃ X'_1,X'_2 such that τ[X'_1;X'_2] < τ[X1;X2].
uncertain_dependencies: Lemma lem-bsg [UNCERTAIN: 通过 Lemma lem:abstract 间接使用]

entities.label: Lemma lem:100pc
entities.statement: If d(X1,X2)=0 then ∃ subgroup H s.t. d(X1,U_H)=d(X2,U_H)=0.

entities.label: Proposition projections-1
entities.statement: Fibring lemma: d(Z1,Z2) ≥ d(π(Z1),π(Z2)) + d(Z1|π(Z1), Z2|π(Z2)).

entities.label: Lemma cond-dist-fact
entities.statement: d(X|Z, Y|W) ≤ d(X,Y) + ½ I(X:Z) + ½ I(Y:W).

entities.label: Lemma first-useful
entities.statement: d(X,Y-Z)-d(X,Y) ≤ ½(ent(Y-Z)-ent(Y)) = ½ d(Y,Z) + ¼ ent(Z) - ¼ ent(Y).

entities.label: Lemma lem:abstract
entities.statement: If T1+T2+T3=0 then ∃ T'_1,T'_2 with ψ bound involving δ = Σ_{i<j} I(Ti;Tj) and distance terms.

entities.label: Lemma lem-bsg
entities.statement: Σ_z p_Z(z) d((A|Z=z),(B|Z=z)) ≤ 3 I(A:B) + 2 ent(Z) - ent(A) - ent(B) for Z = A+B.

entities.label: Corollary additive-stability
entities.statement: If |{f(x)+f(y)-f(x+y)}| ≤ K then f = g+h with g linear and range(h) = O(K^{C_3}).

entities.label: Corollary partial-additivity
entities.statement: If P(f(x+y)=f(x)+f(y)) ≥ 1/K then ∃ homomorphism g with P(f(x)=g(x)) ≫ K^{-C_4}.

entities.label: Corollary u3-inverse
entities.statement: If ‖f‖_{U^3(F2^n)} ≥ 1/K then ∃ quadratic P s.t. |2^{-n} Σ f(x)(-1)^{P(x)}| ≫ K^{-C_5}.

entities.label: Theorem th13
entities.statement: Weak PFR over Z: if |A+A|≤K|A| then ∃ A'⊆A, |A'|≥K^{-C1/2}|A| with dim A'≤C2 log K.

proof_framework.strategy_summary: 本文的核心策略是将组合形式的 PFR 猜想转化为熵形式的等价表述，然后通过极小化一个含惩罚项的 tau 泛函来证明熵形式 PFR。关键在于证明 Proposition de-prop：若两个随机变量的 Ruzsa 熵距离为正，则可构造新的变量对使 tau 泛函严格递减。证明采用反证法，测试四种构造（和与纤维），并利用特征 2 的特殊性质在终局中通过 Balog-Szemerédi-Gowers 引理导出矛盾。

completeness_check.summary: 论文核心技术引自 [GMT] 的熵框架和纤维引理，以及 [tao-entropy] 的熵 Balog-Szemerédi-Gowers 引理。证明在特征 2 下完全自包含，常数 C=12 是具体的。
